fields.name: state-json
fields.description: Data-owned durable run progress and immutable completed revision manifest. Existing business keys remain unchanged.

fields.name: record-status
fields.description: active from latest successful class read, or dropped after a successful complete class response. Failures never drop records.

fields.name: retained-json
fields.description: Frozen sanitized source/projection payload part; immutable once its owning run is completed.

fields.name: retained-sha256
fields.description: SHA256 of the exact UTF-8 retained-json value. Does not replace source semantic fingerprint.
